name: Ren'ai Banchou! Inochi Mijikashi, Koiseyo Otome! Love is Power
original_name: 恋愛番長　命短し、恋せよ乙女！ Love is Power
source: Our heroine is pissed off that she can't find her special someone, while everyone else seems to have found theirs. She decides to try the school legend: tie a yellow handkerchief in the school roof that will make a Ren'ai Banchou come and help her with her love issues. However, she ties 7 of them and 7 Ren'ai Banchous come to help her. Maybe one of them is her destined someone...
translation: 女主人公看见身边人人都找到了特别的另一半，唯独自己没有，不由得恼火起来。于是她决定试试校园传说：在屋顶系上一条黄手帕，恋爱番长便会现身，为她解决恋爱烦恼。然而，她一口气系了7条，结果来了7位恋爱番长。或许其中一人就是她命中注定的对象……
